question: What are the most advanced clinical programs in geographic atrophy?

input.sql:
SELECT p.asset_id, a.canonical_name, a.is_combo, p.max_phase_active, p.max_phase_ever,
       p.n_trials, p.n_active_trials, p.lead_company_of_most_advanced, p.latest_activity, p.nct_ids
FROM v_programs p JOIN assets a USING (asset_id)
WHERE p.condition_key = 'D057092'
ORDER BY p.max_phase_ever DESC NULLS LAST, p.max_phase_active DESC NULLS LAST, p.n_active_trials DESC
LIMIT 30
SELECT count(DISTINCT asset_id) AS n_programs FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key = 'D057092'

WITH scope AS (SELECT DISTINCT asset_id FROM v_programs WHERE condition_key = 'D057092')
SELECT coalesce(b.provenance,'none') AS tier, count(*) AS n_assets
FROM scope s LEFT JOIN v_moa_best b USING (asset_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT m.asset_id, m.moa_label, m.action, m.targets
FROM v_moa_best m
WHERE m.asset_id IN ('brolucizumab','avacincaptadpegol','ranibizumab','pegcetacoplan','vonaprument','pozelimab','cemdisiran','tinlarebant','alk001','emixustat')

SELECT asset_id, phase_norm, overall_status FROM v_trials t JOIN trial_assets ta USING(nct_id)
WHERE ta.asset_id='ranibizumab' AND t.nct_id IN ('NCT01775124','NCT02130024','NCT02161575','NCT03927690')
SELECT asset_id, moa_label, targets FROM v_moa_best WHERE asset_id IN ('pegcetacoplan','avacincaptadpegol','brolucizumab','vonaprument','pozelimab','cemdisiran','tinlarebant')
SELECT * FROM v_moa WHERE asset_id IN ('pegcetacoplan','avacincaptadpegol','brolucizumab','vonaprument','pozelimab','cemdisiran','tinlarebant')
SELECT nlm_class FROM asset_nlm_classes WHERE asset_id IN ('pegcetacoplan','avacincaptadpegol','brolucizumab','vonaprument','pozelimab','cemdisiran','tinlarebant');
